gems.title: 欢迎来龙餐馆
gems.titleEn: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
gems.summary: 徐福为养家还债远赴中东中餐馆当厨师，在当地结识了大堂经理马俊生。他们以地道中国风味广招八方来客，龙餐馆声名鹊起。然而随着战争爆发，当地形势急转直下，没有人能够独善其身，徐福和马俊生也不例外，他们的命运将何去何从？战火中的龙餐馆又将如何维系？
gems.summaryEn: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds w
gems.whyWatch: 从中国厨师视角呈现战火中小人物的生存与道义，9.26高分不容错过。
gems.whyWatchEn: A gripping war drama from a Chinese chef's perspective, with a 9.26 score that demands attention.
gems.audience: 喜欢战争史诗与人性挣扎的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who appreciate war epics and human struggles.

gems.title: 属于我的孩子
gems.summary: 在这部令人震惊的纪录片中，承受家人和社会的期望的女子迫切地想要个孩子，因此假装怀孕，并卷入一起犯罪。
gems.summaryEn: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.
gems.whyWatch: 假孕骗局背后的社会压力令人震惊，真实案件纪录片尺度与深度兼备。
gems.whyWatchEn: A shocking true-crime documentary about a fake pregnancy driven by family and societal pressure, both raw and profound.
gems.audience: 对社会议题与真实罪案纪录片感兴趣的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers interested in social issues and true-crime documentaries.

gems.title: 维什瓦纳特父子
gems.summary: 桑贾伊·维什瓦纳特是一位备受赞誉的专业手枪射击运动员，年过四十，在名利场上可谓功成名就。然而，当他与二十多岁的女孩玛迪相遇后，两人之间因较大的年龄差距产生了种种碰撞与问题，迫使他们不得不重新审视并坦然面对。
gems.summaryEn: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that th
gems.whyWatch: 射击冠军与年轻女孩的忘年恋，把中年荣耀与情感脆弱刻画得细致动人。
gems.whyWatchEn: A poignant intergenerational romance that dissects a champion's midlife glory and vulnerability.
gems.audience: 喜欢聚焦人物内心与非常规爱情故事的影迷。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of character-driven drama and unconventional love stories.

gems.title: 我们未曾有过的
gems.summary: 改编自爱丽丝·凯伦（Alice Kellen）同名畅销小说。失去父母后，有志成为画家的利亚（Leah）难以应对。当她的哥哥搬走后，他请最好的朋友阿克塞尔（Axel）照顾她，却不知道她对他一直以来的感情。
gems.summaryEn: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grap
gems.whyWatch: 失去至亲后的治愈之恋，原著名著改编的情感层次丰富催泪。
gems.whyWatchEn: A healing love story after loss, beautifully adapted from a bestselling novel with rich emotional layers.
gems.audience: 喜欢原著名著改编和细腻青春爱情片的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of book adaptations and delicate youthful romance.

gems.title: 斯图尔特未能拯救宇宙
gems.titleEn: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
gems.summary: 故事聚焦《大爆炸》的漫画书老板斯图尔特·布鲁姆，他弄坏了一个谢尔顿和莱纳德制造的设备，意外导致了多元宇宙的世界末日，他必须与女友Denise、地质学家Bert和量子物理学家Barry一起去将现实复原。一路上，他们遇到了平行宇宙版本的各个《大爆炸》角色，事情进展并不顺利。
gems.summaryEn: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.
gems.whyWatch: 漫画店老板意外毁灭世界又踏上乱斗式修复之旅，评分9.0的爆笑衍生作。
gems.whyWatchEn: A hilarious spinoff where a comic book owner accidentally ends the universe and must fix it, rated 9.0.
gems.audience: 《生活大爆炸》粉丝与喜欢无厘头科幻喜剧的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Big Bang Theory fans and lovers of silly sci-fi comedy.

gems.title: 绿灯军团
gems.summary: 跟随约翰·斯图尔特与绿灯军团传奇哈尔·乔丹的脚步，看这两位星际警察如何深入美国腹地，调查一起谋杀命案。
gems.summaryEn: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.
gems.whyWatch: 哈尔·乔丹与约翰·斯图尔特的搭档调查，DC剧集首次把星际警察拍出纪实质感。
gems.whyWatchEn: Hal Jordan and John Stewart team up in a grounded interstellar murder investigation, a fresh take on DC's space cops.
gems.audience: 喜欢DC宇宙与星际侦探故事的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of DC universe and interstellar detective stories.

gems.title: 重器
gems.summary: 以改革开放初期至1997年《刑诉法》《刑法》修订为背景，讲述陈一众、余高远、张丽慧、夏英杰等法学院毕业生在不同司法岗位上历经风雨、共同见证中国法治发展进程的故事，展现他们在时代浪潮中成长、抉择与命运交织的群像篇章。
gems.summaryEn: In the early years of China's reform and opening-up, five law school graduates—Chen Yizhong, Yu Gaoyuan, Lu Zeming, Xia Yingjie, and Zhang Lihui—embarked on diverse careers within the judicial system.
gems.whyWatch: 从法学生到司法中坚，见证中国法治几十年变迁的厚重年代群像。
gems.whyWatchEn: A sweeping legal drama tracing Chinese judicial reform through law graduates' intertwined fates.
gems.audience: 对法治进程、年代剧与人物成长感兴趣的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers interested in legal history, period drama, and character growth.

gems.title: 仙逆
gems.summary: 改编自耳根同名小说《仙逆》，讲述了乡村平凡少年王林以心中之感动，逆仙而修，求的不仅是长生，更多的是摆脱那背后的蝼蚁之身。他坚信道在人为，以平庸的资质踏入修真仙途，历经坎坷风雨，凭着其聪睿的心智，一步一步走向巅峰，凭一己之力，扬名修真界。
gems.summaryEn: It tells the story of Wang Lin, an ordinary young man in the countryside, who is moved by his heart and cultivates against immortality. His pursuit is not only for longevity, but also for getting rid
gems.whyWatch: 平凡少年逆仙而修的国漫翘楚，154集长线叙事越看越入迷。
gems.whyWatchEn: A standout Chinese animation about an ordinary boy's defiant path to immortality; 154 episodes of gripping cultivation storytelling.
gems.audience: 喜欢修仙玄幻与爽感成长叙事的国漫观众。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of cultivation fantasy and exhilarating progression narratives.
